items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: And we accompanied him with the band you know, came in on his finales and so forth.

ctx.x: At the Carlisle and I'm quite excited about it, this is a new room for me. I've never played there. And actually, it's really you might say Bobby Short's room. He's played there for so many years. And it is partly due to Bobby that I'm going in there. He was kind enough to suggest me as somebody to play there for the two months that he's away and naturally, I'm looking forward to it very much.
Here's something very interesting. Bobby Short when I was in Chicago, that was in about
1930, oh gosh, 1930, oh what was it, 1935, '36?
